items.title: Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1957-04-20
items.q: Well, who was the one that took Foster Lewis's place? A guy named Jake White.

ctx.x: He didn't come to New Orleans with you. No, that's Foster Lewis didn't. No.
Well, who was the one that took Foster Lewis's place? A guy named Jake White.
I just told you, he was the best player that I've ever heard in my life.
